title: Menu
description: The dishes and drinks of the hotel's restaurant, with prices and photos. Dishes on sale show on the hotel's website.
readOnly: You can only view the menu. The owner and managers can change it.

empty.title: No dishes yet
empty.body: The menu tells guests what the hotel's restaurant serves before they arrive: each dish has a name, a price, a photo and a group (Mains, Drinks…). Dishes on sale show on the hotel's website, in the Restaurant menu block.
empty.note: Guests only read the menu; the website takes no food orders. With no dishes, the website does not show the block.

form.name: Name
form.categoryHint: Dishes of one group show together on the website.
form.photoUrl: Or paste a link to the photo
form.photoInvalid: The photo link must start with http:// or https://
form.photoTooLarge: A photo is at most 5 MB
form.photoNoStorage: No photo storage is set up yet, so photos cannot be uploaded. Paste a link to the photo below instead.
form.availableHint: Untick to hide the dish from the website without deleting it.
form.priceInvalid: The price must be a number of 0 or more
